mission: Universal reusable game asset creation, editing and verification; not an individual game.
definition_of_done: All applicable quality gates pass with reproducible source, target-game import, visual reference signoff, representative hardware and recorded provenance. Perfect aesthetics cannot be guaranteed or declared by automation.

excluded: automatic edits to VEILBOUND or ECHOFORM games

status_legend.partial: component exists but acceptance criteria incomplete

milestones.name: Verified asset IO & provenance
milestones.objective: Ensure safe input, immutable source hashes, per-run manifests, license/provenance and failure-closed handoffs.
milestones.acceptance: Source-hash equality, malicious/path traversal tests and signed workflow evidence.

milestones.name: Non-destructive operation stacks
milestones.objective: Composable sculpt, smooth, stamp, adaptive refine, undo/replay and layer toggles.
milestones.acceptance: Deterministic tests; source file unchanged; roundtrip replay/disable and per-layer audit.

milestones.name: Conforming adaptive edge subdivision
milestones.objective: Selectively subdivide geometric edges with no T-junctions across face and UV seams.
milestones.acceptance: Conforming 1/2/3 edge-split cases on both sides, geometry/topology counts unchanged except triangles.

milestones.name: Repair bad topology by region
milestones.objective: Diagnose duplicate, degenerate, nonmanifold and boundary sources; targeted conservative healing.
milestones.acceptance: No unexplained boundary/nonmanifold increases and hole changes represented in review manifest.

milestones.name: Brush mask safety and smoothing
milestones.objective: Surface-aware brush masks, hard seam pinning, no shrink/inversion, cross-family tests.
milestones.acceptance: Sculpt/smooth/stamp QA on character, architecture, terrain and props; no face flips.

milestones.name: Edge-loop retopology
milestones.objective: Deformation-aware retopology for faces, joints, fabric and organic bodies.
milestones.acceptance: Manually reviewed edge-loop flow and rig-safe mesh on three body types.

milestones.name: High-to-low detail transfer
milestones.objective: Create controlled LOD meshes with normal/detail baking, safe silhouette preservation.
milestones.acceptance: Three mesh tiers with zero missing material regions and measured view error.

milestones.name: True sculpt mode in headless DCC
milestones.objective: Blender-compatible mesh modifiers and sculpt scene exports with reproducible profiles.
milestones.acceptance: CI actually imports assets to Blender and exports comparable QA geometry.

milestones.name: Geometry copy/transfer with constraints
milestones.objective: Feature-aware stamp and eventual cross-mesh mesh-part transfer preserving topology.
milestones.acceptance: Transfer only when transforms, materials and seam boundaries pass audited rules.

milestones.name: UV integrity and seam audits
milestones.objective: Check UV coverage, collapsed islands, stretch, mirrored triangles and texel consistency.
milestones.acceptance: UV distortions, seam continuity and black seam pixel regressions are tested.

milestones.name: UV unwrap and atlas packing
milestones.objective: Generate efficient material islands, gutters and static/moving meshes UV sets.
milestones.acceptance: No UV overlaps where forbidden, padding >= specified mip-gutter, measured texel density.
milestones.implementation_note: Triangle-local deterministic non-overlap atlas with explicit pixels gutters and resolution guard now implemented; coherent chart unwrapping, distortion optimization and mips remain unverified.

milestones.name: Texture-rich glTF export
milestones.objective: Color-space-aware albedo/metallic/roughness/normal/AO textures with secure packaged sources.
milestones.acceptance: Actual Android GLES source texture import, image hashes and material channel invariants.

milestones.name: Tangent basis and normal/AO baker
milestones.objective: Compute stable tangent frame across seams and bake normal/AO from high-poly samples.
milestones.acceptance: glTF tangent conventions, mirrored UV tests and real rendered normal-illumination differences.

milestones.name: Physically correct shader probes
milestones.objective: Standard metal/roughness BRDF, light probes and predictable exposure/tonemapping.
milestones.acceptance: Reference scenes in three light rigs; numerical shader and screenshot comparisons.

milestones.name: Photoreal surface libraries
milestones.objective: Scanned/licensed skin, stone, wood, metal, cloth materials with tiling controls.
milestones.acceptance: Documented licenses and representative reference-based appearance approval.

milestones.name: Anatomy and facial sculpt feedback
milestones.objective: 14-angle face, body, hands & feet measurements with review-conditioned correction.
milestones.acceptance: Human reviewer signs off facial landmarks, five fingers and reference likeness.

milestones.name: Skin pore and wrinkle layers
milestones.objective: UV-consistent skin pores, wrinkles, age/pose region masks and roughness variation.
milestones.acceptance: Macro/micro closeups on multiple skin tones/lights without glittering or patch seams.

milestones.name: Rigging and skin weights
milestones.objective: Production skeletons, facial blend shapes, weights and joint deformation tests.
milestones.acceptance: Joint ROM tests detect clipping, pinching, attachment and volume loss.

milestones.name: Hair, fur and cloth solvers
milestones.objective: Real-time hair cards/strands and cloth interaction with rigs.
milestones.acceptance: Stable motion and collision under target Android performance budgets.

milestones.name: Universal parametric asset catalog
milestones.objective: Modular geometry generators for houses, roads, terrain, vegetation, interiors and VFX anchors.
milestones.acceptance: Real source geometry and reusable scene instances for every supported asset family.

milestones.name: World physics and navigation packages
milestones.objective: Collision LOD, navmesh generation, destructible surfaces, portals, occlusion.
milestones.acceptance: Physics/nav validation with importer and multi-scene AI path tests.

milestones.name: Terrain/vegetation/water detail
milestones.objective: Biome maps, erosion, instancing, foliage wind and water surface outputs.
milestones.acceptance: Terrain seams and vegetation LOD tested on real GPU scenes.

milestones.name: Constrained CPU/GPU geometry budgets
milestones.objective: Hard per-tier triangle/vertex, texture memory and job runtime budgets.
milestones.acceptance: Refinement rejects over-budget recipes before writing partial output.

milestones.name: LOD and streaming quality
milestones.objective: Runtime thresholds, glTF extensions, texture mipmaps and asset bundle streaming.
milestones.acceptance: Visual pop, FPS, VRAM and streaming stalls measured across device classes.

milestones.name: CI unit/property tests
milestones.objective: Seeded regression cases for geometry invariants, material URLs, hashes and planners.
milestones.acceptance: Full test suite green, adversarial corrupt mesh and malformed input tests.

milestones.name: VQ fourteen-angle visual source checks
milestones.objective: Hash captured source render frames, silhouette and material features across views.
milestones.acceptance: Independent 14-angle images sourced from actual geometry, no invented screenshots.

milestones.name: Real Android emulator visual acceptance
milestones.objective: Four Android workers import candidate model scenes, sample textures and report frames.
milestones.acceptance: Real 14-angle/device captures, no modal overlays, verified APK and source hashes.

milestones.name: Appearance change and reference regression
milestones.objective: Compare approved golden views, artifact identity, perceptual similarity and localized defect masks.
milestones.acceptance: Review artifacts show actual before/after, configurable justified thresholds.

milestones.name: Motion and temporal artifacts
milestones.objective: Compare posed models over multiple frames and camera moves.
milestones.acceptance: No limb clipping, normal popping, hair clipping, silhouette collapse or frame capture failures.

milestones.name: Real-device performance lab
milestones.objective: Use physical device GPU/CPU/RAM/frame time measurements for target classes.
milestones.acceptance: Stable P95 frame time and documented scene budget on real devices.

milestones.name: Worker DAG and repair decisions
milestones.objective: Bounded parallel workers, failure categories, deduplicated tasks, no surprise merges.
milestones.acceptance: 10 worker cap, no overlap, manifests and deterministic handoff of repair recommendations.

milestones.name: Closed-loop candidate optimizer
milestones.objective: Use approved defect observations to rank bounded refinement candidates.
milestones.acceptance: Measured improvement accepted by geometry+emulator+artist, never metrics alone.

milestones.name: Reusable DCC plug-in SDK
milestones.objective: Versioned APIs for tools, recipe schemas and approved license attachments.
milestones.acceptance: Independent third-party tool adapter installed and contract tested without modifying games.

milestones.name: Quality gates and baseline protection
milestones.objective: No promotion without geometry, glTF, visual, animation, hardware as appropriate, and artist signoff.
milestones.acceptance: Source branch protected, complete evidence, explicit approval artifact, no game mutations.

current_iteration.technical_gate: atlas geometry/UV invariants and high-to-low bake on an actual source-derived refinement
